correctness.rationale: Under stationary common rate-r Poisson resets, age A~Exp(r) and conditional particle positions iid N(0,σ²(1−exp(−2µA))) with σ²=D/µ. S=exp(−2µA) has exact Beta(β,1) density βs^(β−1), β=r/(2µ); V=(logN)S has density β(logN)^(−β) v^(β−1) on (0,logN). Independently derived exact conditional max threshold q_N(v,x)=1−Φ((u_N+x/u_N)/sqrt(1−v/logN))^N, u_N=Φ^−1(1−1/N). At fixed v Gaussian max Gumbel scaling shifts x→x+v; Mills tail-ratio upper bound q_N≤exp(−v/4) for large v yields an integrable beta-weighted envelope for every β>0 and fixed x. Dominated convergence gives Kβ(x)=β∫v^(β−1)Q(x+v)dv=E(G−x)_+^β. Normalization gives the conditional V mark and −log age-offset distribution. At uncorrected threshold sqrt(2logN), N Gaussian tail ~exp(−v)/sqrt(4π logN), another dominated convergence yields scaled leakage Γ(β+1)/sqrt(4π) and distinct β+1/2 exponent. Independent direct 1D Gaussian-mixture quadrature for β=.5,1,2 and logN=16,40,80 corroborated approach to both exact limits (not a substitute for proof). Claims are fixed x and fixed µ,D,r, stationarity, not finite-N uniform bounds.
